reasons: The lake record is verified for record_id Mapp v. Ohio and identifies the case as a U.S. Supreme Court decision with cluster_id 106285.
The disclosed citation fields select 367 U.S. 643 as the official SCOTUS citation and include the parallel/vendor citations in the payload.
For the currency angle, the lake treatment field marks Mapp as good_law as of 2026-06-30; no accepted disclosed edge shows the authority itself is dead law.
residual_risks: Treatment provenance is migration-based; the treatment-specific caveat is handled in the treatment row.

reasons: Quote fidelity/support is outside lens B, so I raise no quote-fidelity defect here.

defect.evidence_quote: Old as_of seeds as_of_treatment; S2 derivation re-derives and may downgrade.
defect.locator_note: content_page.md treatment header and Treatment & subsequent history; lake treatment.scope_note, treatment.derivation, and provenance warnings
defect.problem: The good_law call survives the disclosed treatment fields, but the page should not present the 2026-06-30 status as fully audited without the migration/audit caveat. The lake provenance says the treatment is migration-seeded and the derivation lanes mark audit_needed true with cap hits/proposed negative events.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep good_law / Binding-SCOTUS, but render an audit-pending qualifier or visible scope note next to the treatment status until the R15 treatment audit is completed.

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law, as_of_treatment is 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.
All 28 disclosed treatment edges are proposed, and none has field_iii other than mentioned, so the disclosed record does not contain an accepted overrule/abrogation edge against Mapp.
The same disclosed treatment record flags audit_needed true in lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited and warns that legacy treatment was migrated, so the visible treatment text should carry that caveat.
residual_risks: The disclosed record does not include full later opinions for the proposed negative events; completing the flagged treatment audit could change the final treatment display.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Expose the migration/audit caveat in the visible treatment badge and distinguish accepted treatment from proposed negative edges.
